elements.note: The only room using floor 2 and ceiling 2 -- matt ceramic tile and moisture-resistant gypsum. A turning circle is drawn inside it, the wheelchair clearance the A-03 brief asks for.
Store under the stair: floor 5 (power-floated RC) and ceiling 5 (plastered soffit) -- the only room with no applied finish top or bottom.
Entrance landing, tagged 3 +0.25 with no ceiling number (it is outside). A second tag below it reads 5 +0.10 for the lower step.
Hatched strip along the front marked 'ขึ้น +0.10', running up to the เฉลียง at +0.38. The 1:12 gradient is stated on A-03, not here; the enlargement is on A-18.

elements.note: Wall finishes are tagged with PAIRED triangles pointing at the wall from each side, so the two faces can carry different numbers. Almost every wall is 1/1 (ผนังก่ออิฐ ฉาบปูนเรียบ ทาสี); the bathroom walls show 2 on the wet face (ผนังก่ออิฐ บุกระเบื้องเซรามิค).

elements.note: Openings are numbered in two different symbol shapes. Per the A-01 legend a CIRCLE is a door number and a pentagon/hexagon is a window number, but at 1:100 the two outlines are hard to separate reliably, so the marks are recorded by the shape actually seen rather than being asserted as doors or windows. Circles seen carry 1, 3, 4, 5, 6; hexagons carry 2 and 3. Resolve against the door schedule on A-22 and the window schedule on A-23 before use.
